categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Haohai Biological Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four fast-growing therapeutic areas: ophthalmology, medical aesthetics and wound care, orthopedics, and surgical anti-adhesion and hemostasis. The company develops, manufactures, and sells medical devices and pharmaceuticals including intraocular lenses (IOLs), ophthalmic viscoelastic devices, corneal reshaping lenses, hyaluronic acid-based products, chitosan-based products, recombinant human epidermal growth factor, and medical laser and radiofrequency devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as innovative molding injection for intraocular lenses, patented water-soluble chitosan production, multiple cross-linking techniques for hyaluronic acid gels, recombinant DNA technology for human epidermal growth factor, and multi-phase controlled radiofrequency and VCSEL laser technologies for medical aesthetic devices. Manufacturing adheres to GMP for pharmaceuticals and ISO13485/ISO9001 for medical devices, with a vertically integrated supply chain from raw materials to finished products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals (especially tertiary and secondary grade A hospitals), medical aesthetic clinics, and distributors across China and internationally. The company serves ophthalmologists, orthopedic specialists, and medical aesthetic practitioners, with products used in cataract surgery, myopia control, wound healing, joint disease treatment, and aesthetic procedures. Its products reach over 70 countries, with significant markets in China, Europe, the US, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with major production and R&D facilities in Shanghai and other Chinese cities. It has subsidiaries and operations in the United States, United Kingdom, France, Israel, and Hong Kong, serving global markets including Europe, North America, and Asia. Overseas subsidiaries include Contamac (UK), Aaren Scientific (US), Bioxis (France), and EndyMed (Israel).
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Haohai Biotech operates across the entire supply chain from upstream raw material production (e.g., hyaluronic acid and chitosan raw materials) through midstream manufacturing of medical devices and pharmaceuticals, to downstream sales and distribution. It integrates R&D, production, and marketing, controlling key raw materials and finished product manufacturing, and maintains direct and distributor sales channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in ophthalmic products such as advanced intraocular lenses including multifocal and astigmatism-correcting IOLs, and novel refractive lenses (PRL). It invests heavily in medical aesthetics with next-generation hyaluronic acid products and laser/radiofrequency devices. R&D also focuses on orthopedic injectable products and surgical anti-adhesion materials. The firm maintains a global R&D network and pursues both internal development and external acquisitions to enhance its technology and product pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of medical devices and pharmaceuticals. The company employs a mixed sales model including direct sales to hospitals and clinics and sales through a broad network of distributors. It also earns income from licensing and technology transfer agreements, as well as investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Haohai Biotech is a leading domestic player in China’s biomedicine and medical device industry, holding top market shares in ophthalmic viscoelastic devices, orthopedic joint supplements, and surgical anti-adhesion products. It is internationally recognized in intraocular lens manufacturing and is among the largest independent producers of optical materials globally. Competitors include other domestic and international medical device and biopharmaceutical companies in ophthalmology, aesthetics, and orthopedics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.65 billion, a 24.59% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 416 million, up 130.58%. R&D expenses accounted for 8.29% of revenue. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.1 billion with steady growth in operating cash flow. It maintains a strong balance sheet with an asset-liability ratio of 15.31%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological innovation, comprehensive product lines, and integrated supply chain control to deliver high-quality, domestically produced alternatives to imported biomedical materials. Its unique value lies in advanced manufacturing processes like one-piece molding for IOLs, patented chitosan technologies, and proprietary cross-linking methods for hyaluronic acid products. It offers differentiated ophthalmic, aesthetic, orthopedic, and surgical products with strong clinical efficacy and regulatory approvals, supported by extensive academic and clinical collaborations.
